summary: Use parser command to tell the parser which command the output came from when you run an abbreviated one like sho int.
questions: How do I use an abbreviated command with cli_parse?

answer_card.title: Parser command different from run command
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.utils.cli_parse:
    command: sho int
    parser:
      name: ansible.netcommon.native
      command: show interface
```
